jobs.description: Die Universität Paderborn ist eine leistungsstarke und international orientierte Campus-Universität. In interdisziplinären Teams gestalten wir zukunftsweisende Forschung, innovative Lehre sowie den aktiven Wissenstransfer in die Gesellschaft. Als wichtige Forschungs- und Kooperationspartnerin prägt die Universität auch regionale Entwicklungsstrategien. Unseren Beschäftigten in Forschung, Lehre, Technik und Verwaltung bieten wir ein lebendiges, familienfreundliches und chancengerechtes Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und vielfältigen Möglichkeiten. Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft!In der Fakultät für Elektrotechnik, Informatik und Mathematik sind am Institut für Mathematik zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt bis zu zwei Stellen alswissenschaftliche Mitarbeiter*innen (w/m/d)(Entgeltgruppe 13 TV-L)im Umfang von 100 % der regelmäßigen Arbeitszeit zu besetzen. Es handelt sich um Qualifizierungsstellen im Sinne des Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetzes (WissZeitVG), die zur Förderung eines Promotionsverfahrens oder zur Qualifizierung in Hinblick auf eine wissenschaftliche Karriere in der Postdoktoranden Phase im Bereich Numerische Mathematik, dienen. Die Stellen sind befristet, abhängig von der bisher erreichten Qualifizierung, jedoch für einen Zeitraum von i. d. R. 3 Jahren, zu besetzen. Eine Verlängerung ist innerhalb der Befristungsgrenzen des WissZeitVG ggf. möglich.Aufgabenbereich:Die beiden Stellen sind in der Forschungsgruppe „Numerische Mathematik“ angesiedelt, die ressourceneffiziente numerische Methoden für wissenschaftliches Rechnen und maschinelles Lernen entwickelt. Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt der Gruppe liegt auf der dynamischen Low-Rank-Approximation, einschließlich ihrer numerischen Analyse und effizienten Implementierung. Zu den Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten gehören:• Lehrverpflichtung im Umfang von i. d. R. 4 SWS• Betreuung studentischer Arbeiten• Entwicklung, Analyse und Implementierung numerischer Methoden für Simulationen und maschinelles LernenEinstellungsvoraussetzungen:• Wissenschaftlicher Hochschulabschluss (Master oder vergleichbar) in Mathematik oder verwandten Fachgebieten• Abgeschlossene Promotion für eine Postdoc-Stelle• Wissenschaftliche Fachkenntnisse in angewandter Mathematik, insbesondere in numerischer Analysis und wissenschaftlichem Rechnen• Analytisches Denkvermögen, Teamfähigkeit und Begeisterung sowie die Fähigkeit zum selbstständigen Arbeiten• Programmierkenntnisse in MATLAB oder einer vergleichbaren Programmiersprache sind von Vorteil• Gute EnglischkenntnisseWir bieten Ihnen:• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung sowie die individuelle Möglichkeit zur mobilen Arbeit• Vielzahl von Gesundheits-, Beratungs- und Präventionsangeboten• Attraktive Nebenleistungen wie Kinderbetreuungsmöglichkeiten und Sportangebote• Möglichkeit zur internen und externen Fort- und Weiterbildung• Zusätzliche Leistungen nach dem Tarifvertrag der Länder (TV-L) wie Jahressonderzahlung und vermögenswirksame Leistungen sowie die Zusatzversorgung der VBLBewerbungen von Frauen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht und werden gem. Landesgleichstellungsgesetz NRW (LGG) bei gleicher Eignung, Befähigung und fachlicher Leistung bevorzugt berücksichtigt, sofern nicht in der Person eines Mitbewerbers liegende Gründe überwiegen. Teilzeitbeschäftigung ist grundsätzlich möglich. Ebenso ist die Bewerbung geeigneter Schwerbehinderter und Gleichgestellter im Sinne des Sozialgesetzbuches Neuntes Buch (SGB IX) erwünscht.Bewerbungen mit den üblichen Unterlagen werden unter Angabe der Kennziffer 7456 bis zum 20. Dezember 2026 erbeten an jonas.kusch@uni-paderborn.de.Informationen zur Verarbeitung Ihrer personenbezogenen Daten finden Sie unter: www.uni-paderborn.de/zv/personaldatenschutz.Prof. Dr. Jonas KuschFakultät für Elektrotechnik, Informatik und MathematikInstitut für MathematikUniversität PaderbornWarburger Str. 10033098 PaderbornPaderborn University is a high-performance and internationally oriented university. Within interdisciplinary teams, we undertake forward-looking research, design innovative teaching concepts and actively transfer knowledge into society. As an important research and cooperation partner, the university also shapes regional development strategies. We offer our employees in research, teaching, technology and administration a lively, family-friendly and equal opportunity environment, a lean management structure and diverse opportunities. Join us to invent the future!In the Faculty of Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and Mathematics at the Department of Mathematics the following two positions are to be filled as soon as possibleResearch Assistants (f/m/d)(Salary level according to 13 TV-L)with 100 % of the regular working hours. These are qualification positions within the meaning of the German Act on Fixed-Term Research Employment Contracts for Academic Staff (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz “WissZeitVG”), which serve to promote a Ph.D. or to support an academic career during the postdoctoral phase. The positions are, depending on the qualification achieved to date, initially limited for a period of three years. An extension may be possible within the time limits of the “WissZeitVG”.Duties and responsibilities:The two positions are based in the research group Numerical Mathematics, which develops resource-efficient numerical methods for scientific computing and machine learning. A particular focus of the group is on dynamical low-rank approximation, including its numerical analysis and efficient implementation. The main duties and responsibilities include:• Teaching duties usually amounting to 4 teaching hours (SWS) per week• Supervision of student work• Development, analysis, and implementation of numerical methods for simulation and machine learningRecruitment requirements:• Scientific university degree (Master or equivalent) in mathematics or related fields• Completed Ph.D. for a postdoctoral position• Scientific expertise in applied Mathematics, in particular in numerical analysis and scientific computing• Analytical thinking skills, teamwork and enthusiasm, independent work• Programming knowledge in Matlab or a comparable programming language is advantageous• Good language skills in EnglishWe offer:• Flexible working hours and the individual option of mobile working• Wide range of health, counseling and prevention services• Attractive fringe benefits such as childcare facilities and sports activities• Opportunities for internal and external training and development• Additional benefits in accordance with the collective agreement of the federal states (TV-L), such as annual bonuses and capital-forming benefits as well as the VBL supplementary pension schemeApplications from women are particularly welcome and, in case of equal qualifications and experiences, will receive preferential treatment according to state law (LGG), unless there are preponderant reasons to give preference to another applicant. Part-time employment is generally possible. Applications from disabled people with appropriate suitability are explicitly welcome. This also applies to people with equal opportunities in accordance with the German social law SGB IX.Please send your application documents (preferably in a single pdf file) using the Ref. No. 7456 until December 20th, 2026 to jonas.kusch@uni-paderborn.de.

jobs.description: The Barkhausen Institut performs research on the latest hardware, software and communication technologies and demonstrates their application in tomorrow’s society. Our goal is to build a flexible and trustworthy IoT platform based on reliable electronics and secure communication methods.The Barkhausen Institut group Composable Operating Systems is developing remote attestation solutions and trusted execution environments to advance the security of connected systems.At the earliest possible date, we are looking for aResearch Associate (PhD or Postdoc) “Trusted Execution Environments” (m/f/d)The position will initially be filled for a period of 2 years and will be remunerated in accordance with the public remuneration level TV-L E-13.Your responsibilities will include- Besides contributing your unique ideas, you will work at the level of operating system components and cryptographic protocols to support us in our vision of building secure and efficient platforms:- Design and implementation of system-level software for trusted execution- Interaction with hardware design regarding attestation and root-of-trust- System design using microkernel principles- Development of use cases and IoT demonstrators- Participation in writing research publications and project deliverables- Engagement in Science Communication: In cooperation with our OpenLab team, you will participate in activities that aim to explain research results in dialog with society.We expect the following- Above-average MSc/Diploma and PhD degree in areas related to our research focus (Computer Science) from renowned universities.- Knowledge in the following domains:- Good programming skills in C/C++ and/or Rust- Good knowledge of operating systems and secure systems concepts- Good knowledge of cryptographic primitives and remote attestation- Knowledge of microkernel-based system design principles- An integrative and cooperative personality with excellent communication and social skills.- Good communication and writing skills in English.You are interested, but you don’t think you meet all the requirements of the job posting? Then you should know: We don’t hire resumes, we hire people. We are looking for potential and want to actively foster it. That‘s why we encourage you to apply!What we provide- Cross-disciplinary projects- Influential work on upcoming technologies- An open and creative team- Agile working hours and workflows- Flat hierarchies for your ideas to soar- Competitive salary- Our remuneration is based on the collective agreement for the federal states. Depending on your professional experience, the basic monthly salary ranges between €4.759,37 and €6.764,69. We will be happy to provide more details during the interview.If you have passion for new technologies and the desire to develop the connected world of tomorrow with us, we are looking for you.Life and science are compatible at our institute. We offer a range of recognised family-friendly measures, such as part-time work, mobile working and flexible working hours that take family needs into account.  We also offer support for arriving in Dresden (all formalities, apartment etc.). Application ProcedureYour application should include: motivation letter explaining your decision to apply at the institute, CV, copy of university degree and PhD certificate, short summary of doctoral thesis, list of publications. No data shall be passed on to third parties.Schlagworte: 5G, IoT, PhD, PostDoc, Trusted Execution Environments, operating systems, cryptography, microkernel, C++, Rust, Englisch, Softwareentwicklung, Servicemanagement, servicemanagement, Service-management, service-management, Softwareentwickler, support, Support, Webentwickler, EmpfehlungsbundQuelle/Bewerbung via: https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/177444/research-associate-trusted-execution-environments-m-strich-f-strich-d (https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/177444/research-associate-trusted-execution-environments-m-strich-f-strich-d#apply_form)Kurzinfo zum UnternehmenDas Barkhausen Institut ist ein international anerkanntes Forschungsinstitut, das die Brücke zwischen Grundlagenforschung und der praktischen Umsetzung der Vertrauenswürdigkeit vernetzter elektronischer Systeme schlägt.Wir erforschen innovative Informations- und Kommunikationstechnologien, um die Vertrauenswürdigkeit für eine vernetzte Welt zu ermöglichen. jobs.occupation: (Senior) Legal Counsel, Sustainable Aviation Fuel & Energy Regulation (m/f/d) (Fachanwalt/-anwältin)
jobs.description: DHL Group is the world’s leading logistics provider. We connect people and markets and enable global trade. Our ambition is to be the first choice for customers, employees and investors worldwide. Sustainable aviation is transforming rapidly, and regulation is evolving with it. At DHL Group, you will work at the intersection of law, sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), international regulation and commercial business.In this (senior) legal role, you will advise our businesses on complex regulatory and contractual questions surrounding sustainable aviation fuels and aviation fuel regulation. Your work will cover emerging frameworks such as ReFuelEU Aviation, RED III and ICAO CORSIA, as well as innovative concepts such as Book & Claim. (Senior) Legal Counsel, Sustainable Aviation Fuel & Energy Regulation (m/f/d) Bonn | full-time | permanent Your Responsibilities* Act as a (senior) legal advisor on Sustainable Aviation Fuel, aviation fuel regulation and related ESG matters, supporting DHL Group businesses in an international environment.* Monitor and assess regulatory developments, particularly ReFuelEU Aviation, RED III and ICAO CORSIA, and translate their implications into actionable recommendations for the business.* Advise on Book & Claim structures, including certification requirements, chains of custody and recognition across different jurisdictions.* Draft, review and negotiate complex commercial contracts, including supplier framework agreements, SAF supply arrangements and Book & Claim agreements.* Develop legally robust approaches to SAF-related fuel investments, supply frameworks and commercial solutions.* Partner with Procurement, Finance and other specialist functions to develop implementation strategies that meet regulatory and commercial requirements.* Provide legal support on sustainability-related aspects of investments, M&A transactions, partnerships and joint ventures.* Represent DHL Group in relevant industry forums and networks and share regulatory knowledge through training and guidance for internal stakeholders Your profile* A degree in law or a comparable legal qualification. International legal qualifications are explicitly welcome.* Several years of relevant legal advisory experience, ideally gained within an international corporate environment.* Strong knowledge of ESG, energy, fuels and/or related regulatory matters. Experience in aviation or energy is an advantage.* Extensive experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements.* The ability to analyse regulatory change and translate it into practical recommendations and implementation approaches.* Fluent written and spoken English, including the ability to negotiate effectively. German and additional languages are advantageous.* Strong analytical, communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management capabilities and the confidence to work independently in a rapidly evolving international regulatory environment.       Why Join This Role? This is an opportunity to take ownership of legal topics that sit directly at the intersection of aviation, sustainability, regulation and international commerce.Rather than advising from the sidelines, you will work closely with the business to help turn evolving regulatory requirements into commercial solutions and contribute to DHL Group's wider decarbonization ambitions Your Benefits* Flexibility: Work remotely for up to three days per week, combined with flexible working hours and no core working hours. Arrangements may vary depending on the role and responsibilities.* Workplace & Campus: Work at the Post Campus in Bonn alongside colleagues from more than 60 countries, with excellent transport connections, parking, cafés, restaurants and additional on-site services.* Learning & Development: Benefit from structured onboarding, on-the-job-training, networking, coaching and extensive professional development opportunities.* More for you: Benefits include our employee share programme, company pension plan, mobility offerings, employee discounts, family support, health and inclusion services, sabbatical opportunities and more. Ready to make an impact?* If you are an experienced legal professional who enjoys combining regulatory expertise with commercial problem-solving, we would like to hear from you.* Apply now using the application button with your complete application and salary expectations.* For an initial conversation or questions about the position, please contact Sven Rötzel (DHL Group, HR) at sven.roetzel@dhl.com or +49 228 189 52128.     “We are committed to equal opportunity and reject any forms of discrimination as defined in DHL Group’s Human Rights Policy Statement. The basis for employee selection at DHL Group is qualification, performance, skills and experience.”

Faculty of Mathematics and Natural SciencesPhD Student Position (f/m/x) in “Quantum Hall calorimetry of quantum materials“Institute of Physics II | Bocquillon Working GroupWe are one of the largest and oldest universities in Europe and one of the most important employers in our region. Our broad range of subjects, the dynamic development of our main research areas and our central location in Cologne make us attractive for students and researchers from around the world. We offer a wide range of career opportunities in science, technology, and administration.One PhD Student position is available in the group of Professor Erwann Bocquillon, which specializes in the quantum transport of quantum materials(https://ph2.uni-koeln.de/en/research-groups/bocquillon).The University of Cologne promotes equal opportunities and diversity. Women will be considered preferentially in accordance with the Equal Opportunities Act of North Rhine-Westphalia (Landesgleichstellungsgesetz - LGG NRW). We also expressly welcome applications from all suitable candidates regardless of their gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, disability, age, personal orientation and identity.The position is available from 1 January 2027 on a part-time basis (29,87 hours per week).The position is to be filled for a fixed term until 31 December 2029. If the applicant meets the relevant wage requirements and personal qualifications, the salary is based on remuneration group 13 TV-L of the pay scale for the German public sector.Please apply online with proof of the required qualifications without a photo via the apply button. The reference number is Wiss2610-07. The application deadline is 30 November 2026.For further inquiries, please contact Professor Dr Erwann Bocquillon (bocquillon@ph2.uni-koeln.de) (scientific part) or Dr Matteo Cacco (cacco@ph2.uni-koeln.de) (application questions) and take a look at our FAQs. YOUR TASKSThis PhD project will develop a new ultra-sensitive quantum calorimeter to explore how heat flows through exotic quantum materials. By combining layered crystals with quantum Hall devices, the researcher will be able to probe elusive states of matter with unprecedented precision-starting with alpha-RuCl3, a leading candidate for hosting Majorana-like particles and a quantum spin liquid. The project offers an opportunity to build new cutting-edge techniques in collaboration with partners at the University of Tokyo (Japan), while tackling some exciting open questions in condensed-matter physics.YOUR PROFILEThe candidate should possess an excellent academic record and hold a Masters in Physics, preferably with a major in Quantum Physics or Condensed Matter Physics. Research experience in one or several of the following fields will be appreciated: cryogenic systems, quantum transport measurements, nano-fabrication and cleanroom techniquesAn excellent command of English, as well as high motivation, commitment, good communication skills and team spirit are expected.WE OFFERAn exciting research project at the forefront of research on quantum matterA diverse working environment with equal opportunitiesSupport in balancing work and family lifeExtensive advanced training opportunitiesOccupational health management offersFlexible working time models
